purpose: Independent practice of phoneme isolation and segmentation.
student_learning_goal: I can isolate and segment sounds in CVC words.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can isolate and segment sounds in CVC words.
header.character_watermark: Sounder Sam the Owl in the top-right with a sound-wave necklace. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each picture to its FIRST sound.
parts.visual_layout: Four picture icons on the left and four phoneme bubbles on the right with a connecting space between for drawing match lines.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 first-sound match layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 4 picture icons (cat, dog, sun, mat). Right column: 4 phoneme bubbles labelled /c/, /d/, /s/, /m/. Space between for student to draw match lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_MATCH at Part 1: keywords name the picture-to-sound match task and bubble layout.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 pictures, write ONE sound in each box. If you can't write the letter yet, draw a small mark and say the sound aloud.
parts.visual_layout: Four picture icons each above a row of three blank sound boxes for segmenting into phonemes.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 sound box layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 4 pictures (pin, cup, run, lid) each above a 3-cell sound box. Each cell is large enough for a letter or mark. Pictures and boxes share a baseline.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_BOXES at Part 2: keywords name the pictures with sound boxes for segmenting.

parts.answer_key: pin: p-i-n; cup: c-u-p; run: r-u-n; lid: l-i-d.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 pictures, circle the LAST sound you hear.
parts.visual_layout: Three picture rows, each with three phoneme choices to circle on the right side.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 last-sound circle layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 3 rows, each with: 1 picture on the left (BAG, FOX, JET) and 3 phoneme choices on the right (e.g., row 1: /b/, /a/, /g/). Children circle the LAST sound.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_LAST at Part 3: keywords name the picture-and-circle task for last sound identification.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw your own picture and segment it into 3 sound boxes.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — confirm child can segment a CVC word into 3 phonemes with sounds (not letter names).
